articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Joins $700 Million Hark Funding Round In AI Assistant Bet
articles.description: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) joined Nvidia and AMD in a US$700 million Series A funding round for AI startup Hark, which is valued at US$6b. Hark is working on foundation models, software, and AI-focused hardware aimed at a next generation personal assistant platform. Qualcomm Ventures' participation links the chip designer to Hark's efforts to build AI systems that could reach consumer devices over time. Qualcomm's move into Hark's Series A round sits alongside other shifts in its AI ambitions...
